description: On the tabletop in front of you are a clear rectangular plastic container, a yellow plate with a white sponge-like block on it, a small blue cup, and a beige ring-shaped item. The left hand moves in from the lower center toward the right, pinches and lifts the white sponge-like block off the yellow plate as the left-hand object, carries it leftward over the clear container, then lowers it into the container and releases it.
